name: random-headgear-box
author: rhewid
description: Monsters can drop a Random Headgear Box (0.05% by default) or, with one setting, a Headgear Exchange Ticket that a Prontera NPC trades for costume boxes, one-slot headgear boxes or the Random Headgear Box. The boxes hold headgears nothing in the stock item database drops or sells: 417 in pre-renewal (Snake Head and Skull Cap among them) and 1,207 in renewal. Also includes a Costume Tailor that turns any headgear into costumes. Works in both eras.
